name: Name
targetRefreshFailed: Could not read devices. Check the HDC connection and refresh.
stopBundleConfirm: Are you sure you want to stop {{name}}?
cleanCacheConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear the cache for {{name}}?
cleanDataConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear the data for {{name}}?
uninstallConfirm: Are you sure you want to uninstall {{name}}?
installDropNoDevice: Connect and select a device before dropping HAP files.
installDropReadFailed: Could not read a dropped file. Try selecting it with the Install button.
title: Title
screencastStatusHint: Actual rendered format and frame rate, updated every second. FPS may fall when the screen is still or no frames arrive. This is not the requested frame rate or display refresh rate.
screencastStartFailed: Screen mirroring could not start. Check the USB connection, unlock your phone, and try again.
screencastRetryVideoHint: Keep the current picture while trying H.264 video. Continue using JPEG if the attempt fails.
screencastScaleHint: Original keeps the full resolution for a sharper picture. Smooth halves both dimensions to reduce transfer and decoding work, at the cost of clarity. Changing quality does not guarantee a higher frame rate.
screencastInputFailed: Input failed or is too long. Check the focused field on your phone and try again (up to 64 KB of text at a time).
screencastKeyboardHint: Click a text field on your phone, then type. Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all, C/X copies/cuts, and V pastes automatically: phone content after copying on the phone, or computer text after its clipboard changes. Right-click to choose the paste source. Copying to the computer is not supported yet.
languageRestartHint: Restart Scrcpy Harmony to apply the language to all windows and menus.
settingsSaveFailed: Could not save settings. Check that the application data folder is writable and try again.
workspaceOverviewDescription: Device information and everyday tools, all in one place.
workspaceConnectHint: Connect your device with a data cable and enable USB debugging. If an authorization prompt appears on the device, approve it and detect devices again.
workspaceOverviewFailed: Could not read device information. Check the connection and refresh to try again.
applicationDescription: Browse, install and manage apps on this device.
applicationPartialError: Some app details could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
applicationLoadError: Apps could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
applicationSearchHint: Try a different name or package.
applicationInstallHint: Install a HAP file or include system apps.
applicationDropHint: Drop HAP files anywhere in this window to install.
workspaceSettingsHint: Choose how the workspace looks and connects to your devices.
workspaceBrowseFailed: Could not open the file picker. Try again or enter the path.
workspaceHdcPathHint: Leave empty to use the bundled HDC. Restart after changing the path.
workspaceBetaHint: Include prerelease versions when checking for updates. The application menu stays in sync.
workspacePortFailed: Could not read or update mappings. Check the connection and refresh.
workspaceScreenshotHint: Capture the current screen, inspect it, and export the original image.
workspaceScreenshotFailed: Could not capture the screen. Check the connection and try again.
workspacePortDialogHint: Map a local endpoint to a device endpoint. Enter a port number or a supported HDC endpoint.
processDescription: Monitor running processes and stop applications on the selected device.
processLoadError: Could not refresh processes or stop the application. Check the device and refresh to retry.
processNoResults: No processes match the current filters.
processPollingHint: Refreshes every 5 seconds while this page is active. Select an application process to stop its bundle.
shellDescription: Open device shell sessions and run commands in separate tabs.
shellNewSessionHint: Choose Add to open a new shell.
shellSessionHint: Sessions stay connected when you switch pages. Closing a tab ends its session.
shellShortcutHint: Choose a command to send it to the selected shell. Reboot restarts the device.
shellSessionError: The shell connection or input failed. Retry to start a new session.
shellWriteError: Could not send the command. Check the selected shell and try again.
hilogDescription: Stream device logs, filter entries and export the retained buffer.
hilogLoadError: Could not open or control the log stream. Check the device and choose Restart to retry.
hilogExportHint: Save exports all retained records, including filtered-out logs. At 11,000 records the oldest 1,000 are removed. Restart clears device logs and the buffer.
hilogNoResults: No logs match the current filters. Saved exports still include these retained records.
layoutDescription: Inspect the device hierarchy and select components in the tree or preview.
layoutLoadError: Could not read the layout. Check the device and retry.
layoutEmpty: Refresh to capture the current layout.
webviewDescription: Inspect debuggable pages in the foreground application.
webviewSearch: Search by title, URL or type
webviewEmpty: No debuggable pages. Open an app with WebView debugging enabled.
webviewLoadError: Could not read WebView targets. Check the device and retry.
webviewRead: Targets updated. Refreshes every 2 seconds while this page is visible.
webviewPollingHint: Targets refresh while this page is visible.
plusIndependentSelection: Mirroring and HarmonyOS tools use separate device selections. Changing a selection keeps existing mirrors running.
plusDevicesHint: Automatically detect USB-connected Android, Harmony and iPhone devices, then mirror them inside the app.
plusDiscoveryWarning: Could not read these device types. Check USB drivers, device authorization and system device services: {{backends}}
plusAirplayHint: Connect iPhone and computer to the same local network. Start the receiver, then select “Scrcpy Plus” in Control Center → Screen Mirroring (the two overlapping rectangles), rather than the music card’s audio output. The incoming stream is not automatically associated with the selected USB phone.
plusControlHint: Each mirroring session stays bound to its original device when you change the selection.
plusViewOnly: Screen viewing only; remote control is not available yet.
plusControlSupported: Mouse and keyboard control is supported, subject to device authorization and compatibility.
plusAuthorizeHint: Unlock the phone and authorize debugging. On iPhone, trust this computer.
plusOfflineHint: Device is offline. Reconnect it to continue.
plusMirrorStarted: Mirroring window opened. Connecting to the device.
plusStartFailed: Could not open mirroring. Refresh devices and check phone authorization and built-in backend resources.
plusStopFailed: Could not confirm that the session stopped. Please retry.
plusReceiverUnassociated: Built-in AirPlay receiver session; not automatically associated with a USB phone.
plusUpdatesUnavailable: Scrcpy Plus has no independent update feed yet. Upstream update checks are disabled in this development build.
plusMetadataHint: Device detected, but its information could not be read. Check authorization, connection and system compatibility, then refresh.
plusAuthorizing: Unlock your phone and allow the USB debugging connection.
plusNativeDisconnected: Device disconnected. Reconnect it and retry.
plusNativeError: Connection failed. Check phone authorization, USB access and built-in resources. Close other debugging apps using the USB interface, then retry.
plusNativeInputError: Could not send input. Check the device connection.
plusNativeDecodeError: Video decoding failed. Waiting for a new keyframe.
plusInteractiveScreen: Phone screen with mouse, touch and keyboard control
plusStartAllFailed: Could not open: {{names}}. Other sessions remain active.
plusStartAllHint: All available mirrors opened. On iPhone, select Scrcpy Plus in Screen Mirroring, then arrange the windows side by side.
plusModeScope: Startup and layout apply to the selected mode. Other open sessions keep running.
plusModeMissing: Platforms unavailable: {{names}}. Available devices were opened.
plusLayoutFailed: Could not apply the layout. Start the selected devices first.
